answer: To claim a work slot in the garden, each agent posts a 40-unit deposit and passes a velvet rope: one slot per agent. If the agent cheats or abandons its job, the deposit burns and the slot closes. A sybil attacker needing 100 slots must lock 4,000 units while one slot earns 30 per epoch, so payback takes 133 epochs. The ripple is public: every neighbor sees a burned slot, so honest agents pay once, keep the deposit safe, and keep the full reward.
